question: For carcinogenic molecules that contain at least one nitrogen atom, calculate the percentage of carbon atoms among all atoms in these molecules. Additionally, identify whether single bonds or double bonds are more prevalent in these nitrogen-containing carcinogenic molecules.

prediction.sql:
WITH eligible_molecules AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT m.XCL_010
    FROM molecule AS m
    INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.XCL_010 = a.XCL_002
    WHERE m.XCL_011 = '+'
      AND a.XCL_003 = 'n'
)
SELECT
    CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN a.XCL_003 = 'c' THEN a.XCL_001 ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(a.XCL_001) AS carbon_percentage,
    CASE
        WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond AS b WHERE b.XCL_005 IN (SELECT XCL_010 FROM eligible_molecules) AND b.XCL_006 = '-') >
             (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond AS b WHERE b.XCL_005 IN (SELECT XCL_010 FROM eligible_molecules) AND b.XCL_006 = '=')
        THEN 'single'
        ELSE 'double'
    END AS more_prevalent_bond
FROM atom AS a
WHERE a.XCL_002 IN (SELECT XCL_010 FROM eligible_molecules)

WITH carcinogenic_nitrogen_molecules AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT m.XCL_010
    FROM molecule m
    INNER JOIN atom a ON m.XCL_010 = a.XCL_002
    WHERE m.XCL_011 = '+'
      AND a.XCL_003 = 'n'
),
carbon_percentage AS (
    SELECT 
        CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a.XCL_003 = 'c' THEN a.XCL_001 ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) * 100 / 
        NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT a.XCL_001), 0) AS carbon_pct
    FROM atom a
    INNER JOIN carcinogenic_nitrogen_molecules cnm ON a.XCL_002 = cnm.XCL_010
),
bond_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        SUM(CASE WHEN b.XCL_006 = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS single_bonds,
        SUM(CASE WHEN b.XCL_006 = '=' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS double_bonds
    FROM bond b
    INNER JOIN carcinogenic_nitrogen_molecules cnm ON b.XCL_005 = cnm.XCL_010
)
SELECT 
    cp.carbon_pct,
    CASE 
        WHEN bc.single_bonds > bc.double_bonds THEN 'single'
        WHEN bc.double_bonds > bc.single_bonds THEN 'double'
        ELSE 'equal'
    END AS more_prevalent_bond
FROM carbon_percentage cp
CROSS JOIN bond_counts bc
